notes.title: "Yaoling: Mythical Journey" 1.03 Patch Notes - July 9, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where purchasing a Decor Pack on the island didn’t grant the corresponding

items.

Fixed a leveling up display error when using EXP Crystals.

Fixed the element discrepancy in the description of Unta’s ability.

Fixed an issue where the ignore defense effect from burn was not functioning correctly.

Fixed incorrect accessory placement on Flamora.

Corrected several typos in the game.



Optimizations:

Improved the quest tracking system—main quest objectives and marked goals are now

prioritized.

Added a spacebar shortcut to quickly enter the arena in the Martial Tournament.

Added a shortcut in the Yaoling stats panel to quickly locate the Yaoling’s entry in the scroll.

Increased the maximum Spiritual Energy after reaching Rank 2.

Unified the sorting between the Spirit Shrine and the scroll.





Adjustments:

The base damage of all max level damage charms have been adjusted to match their lower level

counterparts, with an added bonus of 10% of the target’s max HP as extra damage.

Except for max level charms, cooldowns for all single target damage charms are reduced by 5

seconds.

notes.title: "Yaoling: Mythical Journey" 1.02 Patch Notes - June 27, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

Fixed the issue where the DLC world would appear black, or where the game would become stuck after speaking with Doctor Ling at the start.

Fixed an accuracy bug with the DLC skill “water blast.”

Fixed terrain issues where certain areas could trap the character model.

Fixed Doomhorn’s animation misalignment while wearing the straw hat.

 

Optimizations:

Improved the display list for Talent Jades.

Auto-pickup is now available while mounted.

Added interaction for the Swing in the player island.

notes.title: "Yaoling: Mythical Journey" 1.01 Patch Notes - June 23, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

Fixed the issue where the combined skills of Cutfinch and Cinderkit would cause the game to freeze.

Fixed the problem where the quest target and arrow indicator were incorrectly displayed during certain quest tracking.

Fixed the issue where the one-way teleportation point would disappear if players teleported to another area after reaching the opposite bank of Flaming Core.

Fixed the problem where the shiny effect would incorrectly display on the left side when riding a shiny Molgron.

Fixed the incorrect skill values for Relitombs' ability description.

Fixed the incorrect description of the Carnitress in the scroll.

 

Extra:

After the teleportation animation in the Flaming Core concludes, the spirit shrine on the opposite bank will be automatically unlocked.

In the player island special store, the daily purchase limit for music note items has been changed to 5.

notes.title: The first major content update "Sealed Plains" is here to trailblaze 2025!
notes.notes:
A missing “friend” has made her return, but alongside a dark force!
To save you, Sister Juna appeared at a critical moment, but fell into an unending nightmare…
The door to the long forgotten kingdom of the Sealed Plains has finally opened! Bring along your Yaolings and uncover its mysteries!

Whose Yaoling’s got the best drip?! The new “Yaoling Accessories” allow Keepers to decorate their Yaolings with 96 different accessories ranging from weapons, wings, headwear, and… wait, is that a rocket launcher?!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/3a30564cf19cace3500b19f91f0dbed56073b20e.gif

Are your legs too short? Constantly running out of stamina? The “Yaoling Mounts” are here to help! There shall be no need to worry about stamina while chasing after shinies now! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/aeb82dc6b1b5c3398e332608b8e44a3e34799981.gif

In addition to the main story, there are many new and interesting side quests that’s been added!
Oh no, Tangtang’s disciple has been captured before he could even start his journey to the east!
Who has stolen Peachstone Village’s book keeper’s “King of Yaoling, Be Gentle with Me?”
The treasure grandfather left… What can it be？
Don't forget to check out these fun side stories after wrapping up the main story! Let’s see what everyone is been doing around the Land of the Ancients!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/f3bca56b67dcc480b4d8de8ba378c264fc1f7e72.png

In addition, we are still hard at work! The update after “Sealed Plains” is already in production, and will include a battle tower mode that many have asked for! At the same time, the team is also exploring new and interesting elements to add to the current gameplay. We will share more of those when the time is right, so stay tuned!

Releasing “Yaoling: Mythical Journey” has been an adventure in itself. There’s been many great experiences, but most of all we’d like to thank all our players and community for the continued support and engagement! We’d love to keep hearing from everyone and make the game the best it can be!

notes.title: "Yaoling: Mythical Journey" Early Access Version 0.96 Patch Notes - September 12
notes.notes:
New game mode "Martial Tournament" has been added!
With the demons under control, the Martial Tournament has resumed. Master Hongfu has received an invitation to send his disciples to participate. Head back to the village to learn about the details!
The Martial Tournament is hosted once per day. The tournament prohibits the use of charms and buffs, and will now deplete Spiritual Energy.
Winning in the tournament will reward Honors, which can be traded for Gold Talent Jades. The Honors Shop will be refreshed every four days.
Come compete against Yaoling Keepers from all parts of the world!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/1e0700f487184ba3c2f93dd1e68a59a59758b0e8.png


In this update, Yaolings will also be getting a new behavior update. For example they can appear to be sleeping or worried.
The new hugging and smacking interactions have also been added. Hugging a worried Yaoling will increase their intimacy.
Yaolings can now also be found sleeping in the wild. While sleeping, their awareness will not increase.


The sorting function in the Spirit Shrine has been revamped, now allowing different combinations of filters to be used together. Details are below:

notes.title: Next Major Update Scheduled for Mid-September
notes.notes:
Dear Yaoling Keepers:

Due to some technical and scheduling issues, the originally planned update for the end of the month will be postponed to mid-September. We appreciate your understanding and patience!

In the next update, we will bring you the following updates and optimizations:
- Controller support and partial keyboard customization
- New feature: Martial Tournament
- More personalized idle animations for Yaolings
- Yaoling stats balance adjustments
- Bug fixes and feature optimizations

notes.title: "Yaoling: Mythical Journey" Early Access Version 0.95f Patch Notes - August 12,
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
Fixed the bug where Bloodthirst from Battusk's line of abilities would provide ATK increase from external healing sources.
Fixed the bug where Reinkoil's bubbles did not deal additional damage.
Fixed the bug where Runic Blaze Charm would cause the screen to temporarily freeze.
Fixed the visual bug for Rhinebeat's line of abilities.
Fixed the bug where the radius of the talent "Infernal Armor" was greater than described.
Fixed the bug where players were able to obtain duplicate food recipes.
Fixed the bug where dragging Yaolings into battle and clicking space will place the Yaoling in an abnormal position.
Fixed the bug where exiting the Training Grounds could cause the game to crash.
Fixed the stats for the starter Lume players receive.
Fixed the stats for the starter Bax players receive.
Fixed the bug where the "Cheerlead" talent did not increase ATK.
Fixed the bug where absolute damage numbers do not appear on it.
Fixed the Yaoling sorting issue when restarting a commission.
Fixed the bug where the pop up window from purchasing Talent Jades did not correctly match the names of the item.
Fixed the issue where commissions already in progress would appear at the top of the list.
Fixed the inconsistent elements of Yaolings hatched from wild eggs.
Fixed the bug where certain Talent Jades would not appear in the shop.

Content Update:
The Laventot's line of abilities will no longer provide mana to summoned units.
Added the complete all function to the Training Grounds.
If both parents have the same SE Talent, the SE talent will now be guaranteed to be passed down.
Swotter's line of abilities will now resist knockback during usage.
Unactivated Spirit Shrines will now display as grayed out on the minimap.
Introspection state will now be displayed during battle.
Charms will show their detail when casted during battle.
Purchasing in the shop will now display the amount of items already owned.
Spirit Gem shops and shops in the wilderness will not reset to the top after selling.
Summoned units will now inherit any stat increases.
Slightly increased the chance of producing Colossal Eggs from mating.
Fixed certain errors in text and dialogue.

Additional Updates:
Added an option to turn off HUD in the settings.
Now able to track custom map markers by an arrow.

notes.title: "Yaoling: Mythical Journey" Early Access Version 0.95e Patch Notes - 8/1/2024
notes.notes:
Gameplay Update:
Introspection: players may now go to the School of Blades to adjust the game's difficulty. Increasing difficulties will grant wild Yaolings better stats and talents, decrease the success rate of sealing, and grant additional Spirit Gems, EXP, and chances to obtain Talent Jades after winning battles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/5e5a0227542499f1c804425854d3da332a529744.jpg

Bug Fixes:
Fixed the error where Weavy's ability description does not match with the actual damage output.
Fixed the bug where Clubfang's random target ability can also target self.
Fixed the bug where Yaolings target by "Mana Lock" will be unable to gain mana even after the debuff wears off.
Fixed the visual error where and did not display as rares in the details panel.
Fixed the bug where Moustrike's ability would be unable to crit due to the "Prideful" talent.
Fixed the bug in certain Yaoling's Hunting Skill after evolving.
Fixed the bug where eggs received from blessing can have both regular and SE talents.

Inventory will no longer reset to the top after using an item.
Adjusted the stats and talents of Yaolings in the tavern.
Added the option to use crystalline in the Yaoling's details panel.
Eggs can now be added using right click in the hatching den.
Charm crafting now displays the required Craft Skills from Yaolings.
Yaoling evolution levels now display in the Yaoling Scroll.
Training Dummy's HP adjusted from 3000 to 10000, DEF adjusted from 25 to 50.
Added the scroll wheel option on all UI panels.
The animation for the statue's blessing can now be skipped.
Added additional visuals to the icons of Yaolings during battles, such as HP, shiny, rare color, and marks. A blue bar will also indicate that it's an elite.

notes.title: "Yaoling: Mythical Journey" Early Access Version 0.95d Patch Notes-July 26, 2024
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where two Fortune's Ward can be obtained on the map.
Fixed an issue where Frosly could not mate with other evolutions of its line.
Fixed an issue where Lurkwulves and Bandiwulves were not able to mate.

Fixed an issue where the elite icon was not visible during mating in the Jade Cabin.
Fixed an issue where allies healing themselves after the use of Thunderous Cleave skill would take damage.
Fixed an issue with Lotmosa's skill, where it added 10x magic power to temporary health but only applied 1x magic power.
Fixed an animation error for Excaladin.
Corrected the skill description for Massacroc to "Gain 80 defense penetration."
Fixed an issue where Nyxsa's buff could only stack up to 10 times.
Fixed an issue where the Gunster evolution line could not learn summoning talents.
Fixed a missing “dark” damage type tag in Noculipse’s skill description.
Fixed numerical display errors in some Yaoling ability descriptions.
Fixed an issue where the "Gale" talent's 100% additional wind damage bonus did not match the actual effect.
Fixed an issue where the “Deft Hands” talent only added 15 points of magic power instead of the intended 15%.
Fixed an issue where Pangoling elites would not use skills when its mana was full.
Fixed an issue where the "Alpha" talent displayed as blue instead of purple.
Fixed an issue where Lumicarp did not self-destruct for a long time even with full mana.
Fixed an issue where Sinrudis could learn melee talents instead of ranged talents.
Fixed an issue where Shadowtail’s skills could not crit.
Fixed an issue where players could repeatedly submit bait during Caravan Expeditions to infinitely generate gold.
Fixed an issue where egg hatching could result in both superior and inferior talents, causing conflicts.
Fixed errors where certain areas allowed characters to walk out of the map.
Fixed issues where paper golem, moss golem, and stone golems taunts did not taunt properly.
Corrected the duration of Ice Spike terrain from Ursalanche's ability.
Fixed an issue in battle preparation where the ground remains blue even though the onfield limit has been reached.
Fixed an issue where the “Consecrated” talent's immunity to debuffs was completely ineffective.
Fixed an issue where Colostiff’s skill triggered infinite lightning strikes, causing the game to freeze.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Zpear line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Bax line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Swotter line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Floop line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Pangoling line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Lullahorn line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Grimpaw line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Masstiff line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Spearfin line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Songcada line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where the abilities of the Moustrike line do not crit.
Fixed the issue where elites couldn't be hatched by eggs.

Talent Adjustments:
Corrected the triggering mechanism for the "Starfall" and "Starfall SE" talents to trigger on hit rather than on attack.
Adjusted "Soul Binding" talent to "Deduct 50% of HP and multiply the amount by 2 to evenly distribute it as Max HP to allies.”
Adjusted the initial orbit radius of the "Boomerang" talent from half the attack distance to the distance between the user and the enemy.
Adjusted the trigger probability of the "Chuck" talent from 25% to 33%.
Adjusted the "Rainstorm" talent to attack all enemies in range every 7 seconds instead of every 9 seconds.
Adjusted the "Chain" talent to reduce damage by 20% per bounce instead of 30%.
Corrected the "Curveshot" talent's refraction angle from 30% to the actual 15%.

Content Optimization:
Adjusted the breeding mechanic so that in the case of multiple gold talents, they are passed on randomly instead of always having the top one passed on. 
Divided bait into two types: ones to obtain materials and ones to catch Yaolings.
Moved mission markers to the top layer for better visibility.
Added a skip prompt for construction animations.
Charm descriptions can now be viewed even during cooldown.
Added a prompt for extra drops from the Charm House.
Added sorting and filtering functions in the Spirit Shrines and various buildings.
Optimized the selecting an selling of Yaoling eggs.
Increased the skill range of Bax.
Caravan goods now sort by total and unit price from highest to lowest.
Commission now sort by level.
Enlarged the font size in dialogue.
Added a button to check rare colors in the Yaoling Scroll (unlocks after reaching research level 10).
Adjusted egg hatching mechanics to increase the likelihood of colossal offspring if the parents have high stats.
Raised the initial spawn levels for later game Yaolings.
Optimized the lineup of wild Melochats.
Improved skill descriptions.
Evolutions will now affect craft skills (will not affect already evolved Yaolings).
Added support for 2560x1440 windowed mode.

notes.title: Pre-Demo Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911534/dc53c06d574cf8ba8f5164e1f1f8671a038abf1f.png

Hey everyone, as always, thank you for the continuous support! As our demo is getting closer to release, we'd like to share our recent progress in development:

Continuously fixing various bugs
Optimizing the balance of combat experience
Optimizing the value of in-game material drop rates
Improving the tutorial and beginners experience
Adjusting the appearance rate of shiny Yaolings
Updating visuals for certain Yaolings
The name Home of the Yokai has been updated to Yaoling: Mythical Journey to better capture the fantasy adventure aesthetic of the game
